dispatch.pageDescription: Notification to users of the system
dispatch.customerDisabled: Customers cannot be messaged from here — the system does not find them by role (0 recipients).
dispatch.allHint: The message goes to every employee and market in the system.
dispatch.inAppAlways: Always on — the message is kept in the inbox
dispatch.telegramHint: Telegram is sent only to the connected group of the chosen market.
dispatch.title: Title
dispatch.groupKeyHint: Re-sending with this key creates no duplicate — the existing message is updated.
dispatch.confirmIrreversible: A sent message cannot be recalled.
dispatch.confirmBroadcast: WARNING: the message goes to ALL users. This cannot be undone.
dispatch.unknownOutcome: The server did not answer in time. The message may still have been sent — it is not re-sent automatically. Check Notifications first; if needed, send again via "New message".
dispatch.smsHint: SMS costs money and goes only to recipients with a phone. If there are more recipients than the SMS limit, the server refuses to send.

push.enabled: Notifications are on — new messages will arrive on this device.
push.disabled: Notifications are off — they will no longer arrive on any device of your account.
push.enableFailed: Could not turn on notifications. Please try again later.
push.disableFailed: Could not turn off notifications. Please try again.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser. To turn them on, allow them for this site in the browser settings.
push.explainBody: When a new order or an important event happens, your phone (or computer) gets a notification — even when the app is closed. Next, the browser will ask for permission: tap “Allow”.
